claim: The web frontend with the WP9b pages and the wired operation controls type-checks and builds from git archive HEAD web in a fresh directory, with the lockfile-installed node_modules linked in.
command: T=$(mktemp -d) && git archive --format=tar HEAD web | tar -x -C $T && ln -s $PWD/web/node_modules $T/web/node_modules && cd $T/web && npm run build
